actions.script:
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
HttpServletResponse response = ec.web.response def job = t ? ec.entity.find("growerp.general.OwnerDataTransfer").condition("downloadToken", t) .useCache(false).disableAuthz().one() : null File file = job?.fileLocation ? new File(job.fileLocation as String) : null if (!file?.exists() || job.direction != 'EXPORT' || job.status != 'DONE' || !job.completedDate || job.completedDate.time < ec.user.nowTimestamp.time - 24L * 3600 * 1000) { response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND) return } response.contentType = "application/zip" response.setHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=\"${job.fileName}\"") response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store") response.setContentLengthLong(file.length()) file.withInputStream { it.transferTo(response.outputStream) }
